      RE:           PERMISSIBLE OPENINGS IN EXTERICR WALLS

               ED    This Notice supersedes DIRECTIVE 19 of 1970.

      There have been numerous inquiries as to the proper interpretation of
      the pertinent provisions of law relating to permissible openings in
      exterior walls, particularly buildings with lot line walls which are
      considerably greater in height than buildings on adjoining lots.
      Accordingly, you are to be guided as follows in regard to this matter:

                      exterior walls.

                       feet in height which are less than 30 feet from either a roof
